chapter: The Grid (levels 71-80, the neon wireframe world of mathematical solids) - regenerated on the desert's ember model (the owner, 2026-10-11, #824): a lead line the ear can follow, its identity in the mid range, the drive carried by arrangement rather than by noise and sub bass; the family's electronic dance root kept
purpose: Master of Game/Music/pulse-synthpop.ogg: written from this file by Tools/MusicBake --tracks --masters <this folder>, brought to the themes' loudness, peaks held under full scale, Ogg Vorbis. The master stays outside the repository (C:/Users/panrd/AI/output/masters-824-chosen on the desktop, with its .raw.wav; every candidate in masters-824); this sidecar is committed beside the .ogg.
generator: ACE-Step 1.5 (acestep.cpp v0.0.5), local, AMD RX 6900 XT via Vulkan -- batch-pulse.ps1 -> generate-music.ps1 -Loop -NoCotCaption
format: 48000 Hz, 32-bit float PCM, stereo -- 48 kHz is the model's fixed native rate

request.caption: Glowing synth-pop instrumental for a neon wireframe world of glowing geometric shapes: a warm, memorable analog synth lead melody you can hum carried in the mid range, glowing arpeggiated synths, a punchy steady groove of kick, snare and toms with a dark ride cymbal playing throughout from the first bar, a warm bass guitar following the chords, a clean electric guitar counter-melody answering the lead, building into a big joyful peak with warm wide synth chords, confident, warm-hearted and driving, warm mid-forward mix, modern polished production, wide stereo mix with instruments panned left and right, stereo delays, spacious reverb, no vocals

measured: generate-music.ps1 end to end 61,9 s (ace-lm + ace-synth + loop cut), exit 0
measured_note: measure-music.py --reference ember on the loop (band shares %, tonal mid %, mid flatness, held-note changes/s, tempo wander %, wrap step dB and its percentile) beside sel.py: the loop cut, dip = the quietest 2 s under the loop's p95 1 s level (dB), quiet = the % of the loop more than 10 dB under it, L/R correlation, knee_pct = the % of samples MusicBake's knee bends

chosen.why: of seventeen synth-pop renders over five briefs, none held both ember's mids and ember's treble with a usable loop: the fuller ones (c4 17.9 %, c10 12.0 %, c13 19.9 % in 200 Hz-2 kHz) put 2.7-3.6 % above 6 kHz, and the dark-drum briefs that brought the treble down thinned the mids. c14 (puppet-aurora's brief with the Grid's character) keeps the treble inside (1.2 %, old 6.0 %) with the best seam of the seventeen (context 0.89, crossfade r 0.99 against 0.97, spectrum cos 0.98), tonal mid 80 %, 3.66 held-note changes/s, no hole, wrap step -2.0 dB (p50). Still outside ember: 6.8 % in 200 Hz-2 kHz (ember at least 9.5 %; old 13.0 %); its 300 Hz-4 kHz share, 5.9 %, sits just inside ember's 5.6 %. c10, first by count of columns outside, has 12.0 % in 200 Hz-2 kHz and 3.2 % above 6 kHz
chosen.how: every candidate measured with Tools/Generation/measure-music.py --reference ember in one run (band shares, tonal mid, mid flatness, held-note changes, tempo wander, wrap step) beside the loop cut's own check, the hole share (the loop more than 10 dB under its loud level), the breakdown dip and the stereo correlation; a seam below its own rhythm, a hole over 15 %, a 2 s dropout more than 20 dB down, a wrap step of 10 dB or more or at or above p97 of the loop's own steps, a seam spectrum cosine under 0.3 or a loop under 30 s ruled a candidate out; the table is on #824
